title.narrative: HIV/TB - Central African Republic (01-Oct-2016-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Central African Republic, TB/HIV, The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC)This program has the following goals: Contribute to reducing TB-related morbidity and mortality, TB/HIV co-infection and MDR-TB. Reduce morbidity and mortality by improving management and treatment of PLHIV (adults and children). The objectives of this program are: Objective 1: Promote HIV combined prevention activities. Objective 2: Strengthen and extend the high-quality service provision strategy for Directly Observed Treatment Short course (DOTS). Objective 3: Ensure access to prevention services for mother-to-child transmission of HIV in Bangui and the provinces. Objective 4: Ensure accessibility and quality of treatment and biological monitoring for PLHIV (adults and children). Objective 5: Prevent TB/HIV co-infection and MDR-TB. Objective 6: Strengthen coordination and monitoring and evaluation of TB and HIV programs

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for CAF-C-IFRCP02
Percentage of MSM reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of people living with HIV initiated on ART who are screened for TB in HIV treatment settings
Percentage of sex workers reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services

Percentage of laboratories showing adequate performance in external quality assurance for smear microscopy among the total number of laboratories that undertake smear microscopy during the reporting period
PSM-other 1: Percentage of health facilities reporting no stock-outs of essential drugs
Percentage of HMIS or other routine reporting units submitting timely reports according to national guidelines
Percentage of HIV-exposed infants receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
Percentage of people living with HIV currently receiving antiretroviral therapy
Percentage of pregnant women who know their HIV status
Proportion of facility reports received over the reports expected during the reporting period
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Percentage of previously treated TB patients receiving DST (bacteriologically positive cases only)
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
Percentage of HIV-positive women who received ART during pregnancy and/or labour and delivery
Percentage of TB patients who had an HIV test result recorded in the TB register
Percentage of HIV-positive registered TB patients given anti-retroviral therapy during TB treatment
Percentage of bacteriologically confirmed TB cases successfully treated (cured plus completed treatment) among the bacteriologically confirmed TB cases registered during a specified period
Percentage of reporting units reporting no stock-outs of anti-TB drugs on the last day of the quarter
Outcome indicators targets and results for CAF-C-IFRCP02
Case notification rate of all forms of TB per 100,000 population - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse cases
Treatment success rate - bacteriologically confirmed TB cases

Notification of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases - Percentage of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed, drug resistant RR-TB and/or MDR-TB⃰ as a proportion of the estimated number of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases among notified TB cases
Percentage of adults and children with HIV, known to be on treatment 12 months after initiation of antiretroviral therapy
